name: Beregsurány (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of red and green triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Beregsurány: a quartered blue, red and green shield with a white horse, a cross, a stag's head and a plant, above a blue scroll inscribed BEREGSURÁNY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: serrated border of red and green triangles
